meta.title: Role teams
meta.description: Manage editable role cards, memories and published revisions.

ui.updateInstructions: Download the tarball and SHA256SUMS.txt to a permanent directory. From there, run the command for your profile, then restart the host.
ui.policyDelegateHint: Delegate specialist work to members. The leader coordinates and verifies delivery.
ui.policyBalancedHint: Delegate when the user mentions a member or the leader sees a need.
ui.policyCustomHint: Specify which work the leader handles and when to involve members.
ui.title: Role teams
ui.name: Name
ui.dirHint: All members share this directory. Select an existing folder separate from the role library.
ui.emptyTeamHint: Choose roles and a lead to start an independent team session.
ui.emptyRoleHint: Create a role and shape it through conversation.
ui.resetHint: Clear the current conversation for {name}? A new session will open with the same role profile and long-term experience.
ui.protectLead: The lead owns the team root and cannot be replaced.
ui.protectParent: This seat has active reports and cannot be replaced independently.
ui.pathHint: Copy roles in use and their snapshots to the destination before changing paths. Restart the host to use the new location.
ui.settingsUnavailable: This host does not provide writable settings.
ui.partial: Team created. Retry to add the remaining members.
ui.keepDraft: Rejected proposals remain in the review history.
ui.libraryFirst: Create a published role before starting a team.
ui.resolveConf: Review the current text in the role library.
ui.duplicateRole: A role with this name already exists. Choose another name.
ui.firstTopic: Tell the role what it does, or ask it to remember a lesson.
ui.deleteRoleHint: This removes the profile and its experiences from the library and ends its coaching chat. Existing team members keep their settings.
ui.roleDeleteConflict: The profile has changed. Review it before confirming deletion again.
ui.deleteHint: Delete this experience from the role profile?
ui.noModels: Enable a model in the host model settings first.
ui.freshChatHint: Starting a new conversation clears the current chat. Your saved role settings and long-term experience will be kept. Continue?
ui.experienceExample: For example, check sources before reviewing a draft.
ui.rememberHint: Ask the role to remember a lesson in your conversation. It will appear here.
ui.resizeHint: Drag or use the arrow keys to resize. Double-click or press Home to reset.
ui.reportAlreadySent: The member sent a separate report.
ui.finishEditing: Save your edits before restoring settings.
ui.restoreConflict: The settings changed. Reopen history to review the latest version.
ui.deleteTeamHint: Permanently remove this team, its seats and their history from the workspace? Role settings, experience and native session logs are kept.
ui.archiveTeamHint: Archive this team and stop its active sessions?
ui.unsavedCollapse: Save your changes before closing the profile?
ui.unsavedSwitch: Save your changes before switching roles?
ui.emptyTimers: No scheduled tasks for this team
ui.deleteTimerHint: Delete this task and its delivery history?
ui.externalChild: This external execution has no DSH conversation.
ui.emptyBriefHint: Capture the current goal, locked decisions, and artifact paths. Only you and the lead can edit; changes sync automatically.
ui.briefLengthHint: Recommended under 1500 chars—keep decisions and file paths only.
ui.briefConflict: The brief changed elsewhere. Choose how to proceed.
ui.briefUnsaved: Save your unsaved brief changes before leaving?
ui.schedulesUnavailable: Scheduled tasks are unavailable in this host.
ui.defaultsEffectHint: New sessions use this model. Training chats and team leaders use this permission. Team members follow their leader’s permission.
